The receptionist sent the ledger ahead to #b#m010003000##k for me. The long entry names the #b#p411##k, but parts of it are missing.
#b#p411##k found his own name in the ledger and didn't care for it. He couldn't tell me much, but he sent me to #b#p402##k on the rooftops.
#b#p402##k filled in the part about the bench. Now to make my way to #b#p313##k.
name: The Dark Lord's Signature
